name: Neural Texture Compression (BCF1 Variants)
aliases: Neural Block Texture Compression with Cooperative Vectors
Neural Block Texture Compression with Cooperative Vectors (BCF1)
definition: A compression method using low dynamic range latent representations (BC1) to achieve similar quality to previous high dynamic range storage methods at the same compression rate, or higher compression rates with reasonable quality drop.
summary: Neural Texture Compression (BCF1 Variants) compresses PBR textures using BC1 latent features and an MLP, offering higher compression ratios than HDR methods by targeting PBR sets specifically.
